infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: CatchYa uses your approximate location to show how far away other opted-in people are. Your exact location is never shown to other users.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: CatchYa uses the camera to take profile photos or scan a QR code when you choose.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: CatchYa needs photo library access so you can choose a profile photo.
